gpac_args.name: floop
gpac_args.desc: loop playlist/list of files, `0` for one time, `n` for n+1 times, `-1` for indefinitely

gpac_args.name: srcs
gpac_args.desc: list of files to play

gpac_args.name: fdur
gpac_args.desc: frame duration for source files with a single frame (0/NaN fraction means reuse source timing which is usually not set!)

gpac_args.name: revert
gpac_args.desc: revert list of files ([-srcs](), not playlist)

gpac_args.name: timescale
gpac_args.desc: force output timescale on all PIDs (0 uses the timescale of the first PID found)

gpac_args.name: ka
gpac_args.desc: keep playlist alive (disable loop), waiting for a new input to be added or `#end` directive to end playlist. The value specifies the refresh rate in ms

gpac_args.name: timeout
gpac_args.desc: timeout in ms after which the playlist is considered dead (`-1` means indefinitely)

gpac_args.name: fsort
gpac_args.desc:
sort list of files
- no: no sorting, use default directory enumeration of OS
- name: sort by alphabetical name
- size: sort by increasing size
- date: sort by increasing modification time
- datex: sort by increasing modification time

gpac_args.name: sigcues
gpac_args.desc: inject `CueStart` property at each source begin (new or repeated) for DASHing

gpac_args.name: sigperiods
gpac_args.desc: ask for a new DASH Period at each source begin ; useful when media timing needs to be reset at loops (TTML, ...)

gpac_args.name: fdel
gpac_args.desc: delete source files after processing in playlist mode (does not delete the playlist)

gpac_args.name: keepts
gpac_args.desc: keep initial timestamps unmodified (no reset to 0)

gpac_args.name: raw
gpac_args.desc:
force input AV streams to be in raw format
- no: do not force decoding of inputs
- av: force decoding of audio and video inputs
- a: force decoding of audio inputs
- v: force decoding of video inputs

gpac_args.name: flush
gpac_args.desc: send a flush signal once playlist is done before entering keepalive

gpac_args.name: drv
gpac_args.desc: video driver name

gpac_args.name: vsync
gpac_args.desc: enable video screen sync

gpac_args.name: drop
gpac_args.desc: enable dropping late frames

gpac_args.name: disp
gpac_args.desc:
display mode
- gl: OpenGL
- pbo: OpenGL with PBO
- blit: 2D hardware blit
- soft: software blit

gpac_args.name: start
gpac_args.desc: set playback start offset. A negative value means percent of media duration with -1 equal to duration

gpac_args.name: dur
gpac_args.desc: only play the specified duration

gpac_args.name: speed
gpac_args.desc: set playback speed when vsync is on. If speed is negative and start is 0, start is set to -1

gpac_args.name: hold
gpac_args.desc: number of seconds to hold display for single-frame streams (a negative value force a hold on last frame for single or multi-frames streams)

gpac_args.name: linear
gpac_args.desc: use linear filtering instead of nearest pixel for GL mode

gpac_args.name: back
gpac_args.desc: back color for transparent images

gpac_args.name: wsize
gpac_args.desc:
default init window size
- 0x0 holds the window size of the first frame
- negative values indicate video media size

gpac_args.name: wpos
gpac_args.desc: default position (0,0 top-left)

gpac_args.name: vdelay
gpac_args.desc: set delay in sec, positive value displays after audio clock

gpac_args.name: hide
gpac_args.desc: hide output window

gpac_args.name: fullscreen
gpac_args.desc: use fullscreen

gpac_args.name: buffer
gpac_args.desc: set playout buffer in ms

gpac_args.name: mbuffer
gpac_args.desc: set max buffer occupancy in ms. If less than buffer, use buffer

gpac_args.name: rbuffer
gpac_args.desc: rebuffer trigger in ms. If 0 or more than buffer, disable rebuffering

gpac_args.name: dumpframes
gpac_args.desc: ordered list of frames to dump, 1 being first frame. Special value `0` means dump all frames

gpac_args.name: out
gpac_args.desc: radical of dump frame filenames. If no extension provided, frames are exported as `$OUT_%d.PFMT`

gpac_args.name: async
gpac_args.desc: sync video to audio output if any

gpac_args.name: owsize
gpac_args.desc: output window size (readonly)

gpac_args.name: buffer_done
gpac_args.desc: buffer done indication (readonly)

gpac_args.name: rebuffer
gpac_args.desc: system time in us at which last rebuffer started, 0 if not rebuffering (readonly)

gpac_args.name: vjs
gpac_args.desc: use default JS script for vout control

gpac_args.name: media_offset
gpac_args.desc: media offset (substract this value to CTS to get media time - readonly)

gpac_args.name: wid
gpac_args.desc: window id (readonly)

gpac_args.name: vflip
gpac_args.desc:
flip video (GL only)
- no: no flipping
- v: vertical flip
- h: horizontal flip
- vh: horizontal and vertical
- hv: same as vh

gpac_args.name: vrot
gpac_args.desc:
rotate video by given angle
- 0: no rotation
- 90: rotate 90 degree counter clockwise
- 180: rotate 180 degree
- 270: rotate 90 degree clockwise

gpac_args.name: src
gpac_args.desc: location of source file

gpac_args.name: block_size
gpac_args.desc: block size used to read file. 0 means 5000 if file less than 500m, 1M otherwise

gpac_args.name: range
gpac_args.desc: byte range

gpac_args.name: ext
gpac_args.desc: override file extension

gpac_args.name: mime
gpac_args.desc: set file mime type

gpac_args.name: pck
gpac_args.desc: data to use instead of file

gpac_args.name: ptime
gpac_args.desc: timing for data packet, ignored if den is 0

gpac_args.name: src
gpac_args.desc: local file name of source content (only used when explicitly loading the filter)

gpac_args.name: allt
gpac_args.desc: load all tracks even if unknown media type

gpac_args.name: edits
gpac_args.desc:
do not use edit lists
- auto: track delay and no edit list when possible
- no: ignore edit list
- strict: use edit list even if only signaling a delay

gpac_args.name: itt
gpac_args.desc: convert all items of root meta into a single PID

gpac_args.name: itemid
gpac_args.desc: keep item IDs in PID properties

gpac_args.name: smode
gpac_args.desc:
load mode for scalable/tile tracks
- split: each track is declared, extractors are removed
- splitx: each track is declared, extractors are kept
- single: a single track is declared (highest level for scalable, tile base for tiling)

gpac_args.name: alltk
gpac_args.desc: declare disabled tracks

gpac_args.name: frame_size
gpac_args.desc: frame size for raw audio samples (dispatches frame_size samples per packet)

gpac_args.name: expart
gpac_args.desc: expose cover art as a dedicated video PID

gpac_args.name: sigfrag
gpac_args.desc: signal fragment and segment boundaries of source on output packets, fails if source is not fragmented

gpac_args.name: tkid
gpac_args.desc:
declare only track based on given param
- integer value: declares track with the given ID
- audio: declares first audio track
- video: declares first video track
- 4CC: declares first track with matching 4CC for handler type

gpac_args.name: stsd
gpac_args.desc: only extract sample mapped to the given sample description index (0 means extract all)

gpac_args.name: nocrypt
gpac_args.desc: signal encrypted tracks as non encrypted (mostly used for export)

gpac_args.name: mstore_size
gpac_args.desc: target buffer size in bytes when reading from memory stream (pipe etc...)

gpac_args.name: mstore_purge
gpac_args.desc: minimum size in bytes between memory purges when reading from memory stream, 0 means purge as soon as possible

gpac_args.name: mstore_samples
gpac_args.desc: minimum number of samples to be present before purging sample tables when reading from memory stream (pipe etc...), 0 means purge as soon as possible

gpac_args.name: strtxt
gpac_args.desc: load text tracks (apple/tx3g) as MPEG-4 streaming text tracks

gpac_args.name: xps_check
gpac_args.desc:
parameter sets extraction mode from AVC/HEVC/VVC samples
- keep: do not inspect sample (assumes input file is compliant when generating DASH/HLS/CMAF)
- rem: removes all inband xPS and notify configuration changes accordingly
- auto: resolves to `keep` for `smode=splitx` (dasher mode), `rem` otherwise

gpac_args.name: nodata
gpac_args.desc:
control sample data loading
- no: regular load
- yes: skip data loading
- fake: allocate sample but no data copy

gpac_args.name: lightp
gpac_args.desc: load minimal set of properties

gpac_args.name: initseg
gpac_args.desc: local init segment name when input is a single ISOBMFF segment

gpac_args.name: extk
gpac_args.desc: allow external track loading

gpac_args.name: ctso
gpac_args.desc:
value to add to CTS offset for tracks using negative ctts
- set to `-1` to use the `cslg` box info or the minimum cts offset present in the track
- set to `-2` to use the minimum cts offset present in the track (`cslg` ignored)

gpac_args.name: norw
gpac_args.desc: skip reformatting of samples - should only be used when rewriting fragments

gpac_args.name: keepc
gpac_args.desc: keep corrupted samples (for multicast sources only)
